title: speciate operation
description: Aqueous speciation: distributes the declared analytical totals over the curated equilibrium network and reports every species, its activity coefficient, the ionic strength, the water activity and the mineral saturation indices. By default it is SI-ONLY — it says which solids are supersaturated without precipitating any. Adding an `equilibrate { minerals ( ... ) }` block lets the NAMED solids precipitate to their SI = 0 ceiling; naming the allowed set is the author's decision and is required, because which solid a brine is permitted to drop is chemistry, not a default.

analyticalTotals.title: Analytical totals
analyticalTotals.description: `{ Na 0.486 mol/kg; Cl 0.566 mol/kg; ... }` — the element/master totals the solution is made of. `totals` is accepted as a synonym.

composition.title: Composition form
composition.description: Alternative to the totals block for a case that states the solution as a composition.

pH.title: Given pH
pH.description: Fixes the proton balance. Read on the single-ion convention of the activity parameterisation in use — a meter reading is NBS and the run says so.

totalsBasis.title: What the totals are
totalsBasis.description: `analytical` (default): a measured ion analysis, where a feed charge imbalance is evidence of lab error and the solved-pH advisory says so. `stoichiometric`: family totals of NEUTRAL weak-electrolyte feeds expressed on the master basis (2.90 mol/kg NH3 declared as `NH4 2.90`) — the master basis then carries a formal net charge no lab measured, electroneutrality is the exact physical closure, and the imbalance advisory does not apply.

atmosphere.title: Open-system gas partial pressures
atmosphere.description: `{ pCO2 4.2e-4 atm; ... }` — every key is a gas the solution equilibrates WITH, so the system is open to it. Each value MUST carry a pressure unit; a bare number is refused by name.

activityModel.title: Aqueous activity model
activityModel.description: Which per-ion model prices the gammas, e.g. davies or pitzerHMW. The model is the experiment's subject here, which is why a props BENCH may name it where a process unit may not.

equilibrate.title: Allowed precipitation
equilibrate.description: Present = let the named solids precipitate to SI = 0. `minerals` is the ONLY key accepted inside; an empty list is refused, and so is any other key (seed and targetSI are reserved and NOT implemented).

diagSpecies.title: Species to pin as diagnostics
diagSpecies.description: Their activity coefficients are emitted as named KPIs, so a golden test can lock them. These are SINGLE-ION coefficients, which are convention-dependent and not measurable -- for the measurable quantity see diagMeanIonic.

diagMeanIonic.title: Cation/anion pairs to publish a mean ionic activity coefficient for
diagMeanIonic.description: Emits gamma_pm_<cation>_<anion> = (gamma_+^nu+ * gamma_-^nu-)^(1/(nu+ + nu-)), the coefficient experiment actually reports. The stoichiometry is DERIVED from the species charges (smallest integers with nu+*z+ = nu-*|z-|) and announced at verbosity >= 2 -- it is never declared here and never read off a salt name. Naming a negative species as the cation, or a species absent from the computed table, refuses.

verifyGlobal.title: Run the full catalogue self-check
verifyGlobal.description: Sweeps EVERY curated Pitzer binary against the closed single-salt kernel instead of only the case's own ions. Expensive, and belongs to the dedicated validation case.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.

networkScope.title: Speciation network scope
networkScope.description: full (default): every curated chemistry record reachable from the feed. restricted: only the records admitted in network ( ... ) -- requires network AND reason; the run announces the restriction, results carry a networkRestricted label, and choupo-import seals exactly the admitted records (D-R1, approved 2026-08-02).

network.title: Admitted chemistry records
network.description: Record file stems (e.g. water-dissociation) admitted when networkScope is restricted. Every name must resolve to a loaded chemistry record and be reachable from the feed; pairing with networkScope full refuses (two authorities).

reason.title: Restriction reason
reason.description: Required with networkScope restricted: WHY the network is deliberately smaller (e.g. HMW theta/psi were fitted to a non-pairing treatment). A reduced network with no stated reason is a trap for the next reader.

vapour.title: Vapour side (Edwards Eq 5/6/11)
vapour.description: Optional. Prices the equilibrium vapour over the solved liquid: each declared molecular solute by p = m · γ · H (its named Henry record, kg·atm/mol, Krichevsky–Kasarnovsky correction from the record's vInfinity), the solvent by p_w = a_w · Psat. `fugacity ideal;` is REQUIRED — φ = 1 is a declared approximation the case owns, never a default. Emits P_atm, p_<species>_atm, y_<species>. The anchor case is edwards02_table7_vle (Table 7 of Edwards et al. 1978).
